comment: Fillet's Mid Radii in a narrow panel (mitcad#2421), tools/ui-fillet-mid-radii-test.sh: a stepped block, a block 20 x 30 x 30 (F1.b0; its top F1:top at z 30, the side F1:side3 at x 0) with a step 10 wide and 15 deep cut from its top at x 10 to 20 (F2). The top's edge at x 0, E{F1:side3|F1:top}, 30 long, is the edge the variable fillet rounds.
